name: Molecule
description: Decentralized science (DeSci) protocol enabling on-chain funding and coordination of early-stage intellectual property (IP) for research. Molecule's IP-NFT framework lets scientists tokenize research projects, fundraise via DAOs like VitaDAO, and license IP to biotech companies.

name: VitaDAO
description: Decentralized autonomous organization funding early-stage longevity research through IP-NFTs. VitaDAO tokenizes research IP, lets VITA holders govern funding, and partners with Molecule to translate academic science into therapies targeting aging and age-related disease.

name: GenomesDAO
description: Privacy-preserving, user-owned genomic data platform. GenomesDAO lets individuals store DNA and biomedical data encrypted on-chain, control access, and monetize it for research while earning rewards via the GENE token.

name: Bio Protocol
description: DeSci liquidity and coordination layer for on-chain biotech. Bio Protocol uses the BIO token to power a network of BioDAOs funding decentralized research, offering launchpad infrastructure, staking, and shared liquidity across the DeSci ecosystem.

name: ResearchHub
description: Web3 platform that rewards scientists for publishing, peer-reviewing, and curating academic work. ResearchHub distributes RSC tokens for open science contributions and aims to create a decentralized alternative to traditional scientific publishing.

name: Cere Network
description: Decentralized data cloud for enterprise and consumer applications, including scientific data management. Cere provides a Polkadot-based DDSM (Decentralized Data Management System) used by DAOs and Web3 organizations to store and control research data.

name: dClimate
description: Decentralized network for climate and environmental data. dClimate aggregates, validates, and distributes open climate datasets, smart-contract weather derivatives, and APIs that researchers and DeSci projects use to build climate models and forecasts.

name: IPFS (Protocol Labs)
description: InterPlanetary File System is a peer-to-peer hypermedia protocol addressing content by hash. Developed by Protocol Labs alongside Filecoin, IPFS is foundational infrastructure for decentralized science, enabling censorship-resistant storage of large research datasets.

name: Filecoin
description: Decentralized storage network that turns cloud storage into an open marketplace. Filecoin is widely used by DeSci and open-science projects to archive large datasets (genomic, climate, microscopy) with cryptographic proofs of storage.

name: OriginTrail
description: Decentralized knowledge graph for supply chains and trusted data. OriginTrail v6 (NeuroWeb) builds verifiable, AI-ready data infrastructure used by science and healthcare ecosystems to trace provenance, integrity, and licensing of research data.

name: Ocean Protocol
description: Decentralized data exchange protocol that unlocks data for AI and research while preserving privacy. Ocean's 'Compute-to-Data' lets scientists train models on datasets (e.g., biomedical, climate) without the data ever leaving the owner's control.

name: The Graph
description: Indexing and query layer for blockchains, often called the 'Google of Web3'. The Graph is used by DeSci dashboards (VitaDAO, Ocean, Bio Protocol) to query on-chain research funding, governance, and IP-NFT data via open subgraphs.

name: PowerPool
description: Decentralized governance and on-chain asset management protocol. PowerPool lets users pool governance power, automate treasury operations, and execute DeFi strategies—often used by DeSci DAOs to manage research treasuries and votes.

name: Gitcoin
description: Decentralized quadratic-funding protocol for public goods. Gitcoin Grants has directed tens of millions of dollars to open-source, climate, and DeSci projects, with the GTC token governing the Gitcoin DAO and funding decisions.

name: Giveth
description: Decentralized giving and donation platform using quadratic funding. Giveth lets donors fund nonprofits, open-source, and DeSci public goods with full on-chain transparency, and routes GIV governance over the DApp and the Giveth DAO.

name: Kleros
description: Decentralized court protocol using Schelling-game juries to adjudicate disputes. Kleros is used by DAOs, including DeSci communities, to resolve disputes over funding, IP licensing, peer review, and curation of open research data.

name: Aragon
description: Framework for building and operating decentralized autonomous organizations on Ethereum. Aragon OSx powers many DeSci and BioDAOs with modular on-chain governance, treasuries, and plugins for managing research funding and IP.

name: Colony
description: On-chain reputation and collaboration framework for open organizations. Colony's reputation-weighted governance, payments, and tasks are used by research collectives and DeSci DAOs to coordinate contributor rewards transparently.

name: AthenaDAO
description: Decentralized research collective funding women's health and reproductive science. AthenaDAO pools capital, IP-NFTs research projects, and distributes research outputs to the public while ATH holders govern the treasury and grants.

name: LabDAO
description: Decentralized biotech collective building open-source tools for computational biology. LabDAO operates PLEX (a peer-to-peer compute marketplace for AlphaFold, molecular dynamics, and more) and uses IP-NFTs to coordinate research IP.

name: Bio.xyz
description: Launchpad and coordination layer for BioDAOs running on Bio Protocol. Bio.xyz (formerly Molecule Catalyst) helps scientific communities spin up tokenized funding vehicles, IP-NFTs, and on-chain research workflows.

name: HyperCerts
description: Tokenized, portable claims on intellectual, scientific, and social contributions. Hypercerts (built by Hypercerts Foundation) lets researchers and public-good contributors issue verifiable, on-chain impact claims and trade or fund them.

name: Data Lake
description: Decentralized platform for consent-based medical and scientific data sharing. Data Lake lets patients and research participants control access to health records and earn from studies that use their data, with on-chain consent receipts.

name: SorcererDAO
description: DeSci community DAO funding and coordinating open scientific research, including longevity and biotech projects. SorcererDAO builds tooling for on-chain research collaboration and connects BioDAOs across the DeSci ecosystem.

name: ValleyDAO
description: Decentralized community funding synthetic biology and engineering biology research. ValleyDAO uses IP-NFTs to tokenize scientific IP and GROW for governance, with a focus on open, public-good outcomes in life sciences.

name: PsyDAO
description: Decentralized collective funding psychedelic and mental-health research. PsyDAO finances clinical and scientific work into psychedelic-assisted therapies, coordinates IP-NFTs, and lets PSY holders govern research priorities.

name: HairDAO
description: Decentralized research DAO focused on hair-loss treatments and dermatology. HairDAO funds peer-reviewed research, licenses IP via IP-NFTs, and uses the HAIR token to coordinate its scientific and treasury operations.

name: CryoDAO
description: Cryopreservation research DAO funding the science of reversible cryopreservation and biostasis. CryoDAO channels CRYO governance over a portfolio of research projects, including IP-NFTs and academic grants in low-temperature biology.

name: AntiHaus
description: DeSci community focused on decentralized peer review, scientific publishing, and reproducibility. AntiHaus builds open tools to challenge the credibility and incentive structure of traditional scientific journals.

name: MoonDAO
description: Decentralized space program funding space research, exploration, and science. MoonDAO has sent members to space via Blue Origin, funds open-space-research grants, and uses the MOONEY token to coordinate the world's largest 'space DAO'.
